company.name: Sierra Space
company.shortDescription: Sierra Space is a commercial space company that specializes in the development of advanced space technologies and solutions.
company.description:
Sierra Space develops aerospace systems and space infrastructure used for transportation, habitation, and operations in orbit. The company designs and manufactures spacecraft, satellite systems, propulsion technologies, and spaceflight components used in commercial, civil, and defense missions. Its portfolio includes the Dream Chaser spaceplane, a reusable spacecraft designed to transport cargo and other payloads to and from space while landing on conventional runways. The company also develops orbital habitation technologies such as the Large Integrated Flexible Environment (LIFE) habitat, an expandable structure designed to support research, manufacturing, and other activities in microgravity. These systems can be deployed as modules for commercial space stations or other orbital platforms.

Sierra Space participates in the development of orbital destinations and infrastructure, including collaboration on commercial space station projects that support research, industrial activity, and other operations in low Earth orbit. The organization also produces spacecraft subsystems such as solar power systems, environmental control equipment, propulsion components, and thermal management technologies used in satellites and spacecraft.

aiResearchSummary.text: Sierra Space is engaged in developing advanced space technologies such as a debris-tolerant sealing valve for reliable system operation, continuous production systems for thermochemical reactions, flip-chip solar cells for efficient energy conversion, reaction control vortex thruster systems, liquid propellant injectors for vortex hybrid rocket motors, plant growth systems for microgravity, mounting flanges and brackets for space habitats, and hybrid rocket oxidizer flow control systems. These efforts span propulsion, energy, life support, and habitat integration.
